title: Run an owned CLI process
responsibility: Runs a CLI command with bounded output and time, forwarding complete output lines and supporting cancellation.

inputs.name: killOwnedProcess.pid
inputs.description: The owned process ID to terminate, or undefined to do nothing. On Windows it targets that process; elsewhere it targets the process group with that ID.

inputs.name: cliProcess.command
inputs.description: The executable and arguments to spawn directly with the prepared CLI environment and piped input and output.

inputs.name: cliProcess.options
inputs.description: Optional working directory, input text, cancellation signal, output-line callback and limits. Defaults are empty input, ten minutes and 16,000,000 output bytes. An already-aborted signal prevents the process from starting.

outputs.name: killOwnedProcess
outputs.description: No return value. Sends SIGTERM to the owned target; termination errors, including an already-exited process, are ignored.

outputs.name: cliProcess
outputs.description: A promise for UTF-8 standard output when the process exits with code zero. Rejects for startup failures, cancellation, timeout, excessive output or nonzero exit. Nonzero-exit messages include up to the last 2,000 characters of standard error.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects with RunCancelled when the supplied signal is already aborted or is aborted while the process runs. Active cancellation also sends termination to the owned process or process group.
